source: Kandal Provincial Department of Agriculture (មន្ទីរកសិកម្មខេត្តកណ្តាល), "ដំណំពោត" (Corn Crop / Zea mays production manual), 2015
text:
White grub (ដង្គូវជីង, White grubs, Phyllophaga spp; Order Coleoptera, Family Scarabaeidae, Subfamily Melolonthinae): the adult is a beetle with a round body shape and dark greenish/blackish coloring, glossy in appearance. During the larval stage, this insect is known as the white grub -- the larva has a curled, C-shaped body, about 0.5 cm in width and about 1 cm long. This species lives underground and in the soil, feeding on plant roots.

After hatching, larvae feed on organic matter and roots in the soil, and are pale/whitish grubs with a curled body shape and an orange-brown head capsule.
